title: You Earn $153 to Spend $100 — Here's Why
hook: Nobody ever explains that by the time you spend $100, you already paid $53 in hidden taxes to earn it.
angle: Reframes every purchase as a pre-tax cost — the combined weight of federal income tax, FICA payroll tax, state income tax, and sales tax stacked on every single dollar spent
audience: Anyone who earns a paycheck and has never calculated the true cost of spending
key_numbers: 7.65% FICA payroll tax on every dollar earned
Every $100 purchase requires ~$153 in gross earnings
